title: Rotationally symmetric critical metrics for Laplace eigenvalues on tori in a conformal class
summary: We study the problem of maximizing the first Laplace-Beltrami eigenvalue normalized by area in a conformal class on a torus. By a result of Nadirashvili, El Soufi, and Ilias, critical metrics for the $k$-th normalized Laplace-Beltrami eigenvalue functional $\barλ_k$ in a conformal class correspond to harmonic maps to spheres. In this paper we construct certain $\mathbb S^1$-equivariant harmonic maps $\mathbb T^2\to\mathbb S^3$.
